section-labeler._comment: labels document sections with descriptive label+desc fields

scout-filter._comment: identifies contiguous off-topic blocks to exclude from documents

hyde-generator._comment: generates hypothetical passages for corpus-specific semantic search (HyDE)

topic-assigner._comment: classifies documents by type and subject facets

corpus-describer._comment: profiles document groups for downstream hyde-generator context

generic-hyde._comment: generates hypothetical passages for search without corpus context

file-hyde._comment: generates highlight and hypothetical passages from a file for similarity search

semantic-filter._comment: selects sentences matching a search intent from numbered sentence lists

deep-analysis-filter._comment: step 2: independent review — keep/remove judgment per code

deep-analysis-adjudicate._comment: step 3: tie-breaker over filter's contested items with cross-code awareness — keep/reject/inconsistent verdict

qual-coder._comment: main qualitative coding agent — annotates research text against codebook

refine-code._comment: reviews codebook definitions against flagged passages for quality

compacter._comment: summarizes conversation history for context compaction

commit-agent._comment: groups git changes into coherent commits with researcher-language messages
